name: Taberno (Spain)
description: A white hoist third with a wavy edge bearing a green almond tree in its upper part, the fly green with the crowned municipal arms of Taberno (a sun and a tree on blue and white) in the lower fly.
history: Taberno adopted its arms officially on 6 July 1987 and its flag on 9 February 2012; the flag is a cloth of 2:3 with a white indented and wavy hoist third bearing an almond tree in its upper canton, the fly green with the arms in its lower canton.
